Ишларни бажариш ёки хизматларни кўрсатиш учун тегишли зарурий жиҳозлар, асбоблар ва технологик воситаларга қўйиладиган талаблар. reasons_uz: Hujjatda raqobatni jiddiy cheklashi mumkin bo'lgan bir nechta shart bor; ularga aniqlik kiritilmaguncha qatnashish tavsiya etilmaydi.

Brend yoki model ko'rsatilgan, ekvivalentga ruxsat berilmagan (7-bet): Yetkazib beriladigan 7 ta uskuna aniq marka va buyurtma kodlari bilan ko'rsatilgan (Nivotester, Liquiphant, Levelflex, iTHERM), "yoki ekvivalent" deyilmagan. Bu faqat bitta ishlab chiqaruvchining tarmog'idagi yetkazib beruvchilarni qoldirishi mumkin; lot qiymati 1,4 mlrd so'm. Lot mavjud tizim komponentlarini almashtirishga oid bo'lgani uchun moslik sababi bo'lishi mumkin; shunga qaramay «yoki ekvivalenti» iborasi yo'q.

Lot hajmiga nomutanosib tajriba yoki resurs talabi (platformadagi mezonlar): Mezon 4 bo'yicha 9 ball neft-gaz, aviatsiya yoqilg'isi yoki kimyo obyektlaridagi shartnomalarga beriladi. Texnik qismning maksimal bali 37 (8+8+6+9+6), o'tish bali 30; bu mezonda 0 ball olgan ishtirokchi ko'pi bilan 28 ball to'plashi mumkin, ya'ni o'tish balidan past. Portlash xavfli muhitda tajriba ahamiyatli, lekin umumiy portlashdan himoyalangan avtomatlashtirish tajribasi ham qabul qilinishi mumkin.

Bajarish qiyin bo'lgan muddat (8-bet): Texnik topshiriqda ishlar muddati 2026-yil sentabr-noyabr deb ko'rsatilgan, lekin lot 2026-yil 16-noyabrda e'lon qilingan va takliflar 23-noyabrda yopiladi. Muddat o'tib ketgan yoki bir necha kun qolgan bo'lib, e'londagi 365 kunlik muddatga zid. Ishtirokchi qaysi muddatga rioya qilishini bilmaydi.
Buyurtmachining so'nggi 28 ta savdosida ishtirokchilar medianasi 3 ta; savdolarning 29% qismida ikki yoki undan kam ishtirokchi; eng ko'p g'olib bo'lgan yetkazib beruvchi ulushi 7%.
Diqqat: hujjatning 2 ta sahifasi mashina o'qiy olmaydigan skan, ular tahlil qilinmadi.
reasons_en: The document holds several conditions that may seriously limit competition; bidding is not advised until they are clarified.

Brand or model named with no equivalent allowed (page 7): Seven supplied instruments are specified by exact brand lines and order codes with no 'or equivalent' wording. This may leave only suppliers within one manufacturer's channel; the lot is worth 1.4 billion UZS. The lot replaces components of an existing system, so a compatibility reason is conceivable; still, no 'or equivalent' wording is given.

Experience or resource demand out of proportion to the lot (platform criteria form): Criterion 4 gives 9 points only for contracts at oil, aviation-fuel or chemical sites. Maximum technical score is 37 (8+8+6+9+6) with a pass mark of 30, so a bidder scoring 0 here can reach at most 28, below the pass mark. Hazardous-area experience matters, but explosion-protected automation work at other site types could also be accepted.

Deadline that is hard to meet (page 8): The specification sets the works period as September to November 2026, yet the lot was published on 16 November 2026 and bids close on 23 November, while the lot header lists 365 days. Bidders cannot tell which period applies.
In the customer's last 28 deals the median number of bidders was 3; 29% of deals had two or fewer bidders; the most frequent winner took 7%.
Note: 2 page(s) of the document are scans without readable text and were not analysed.
